# Docsumo

Docsumo is an AI-powered document processing platform that automates data extraction and analysis from various document types.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/docsumo/.

## Actions

- **Get Enabled Document Types** (read-only): Retrieve enabled document types summary for the user.
- **Get User Document Types** (read-only): List available user document types and user info.
- **MCA Analysis**: Perform merchant cash advance (mca) analysis on bank statements.
